integrity: New combinatorial proof and standalone reproducibility checks supplied; no assertion of external or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to binary words with at most five runs; exact length-seven obstruction census; no claim about all longer or larger-alphabet inputs. Exhaustive code confirms finite cases but is not the infinite proof. Literature equivalence beyond inspected sources remains possible.
title: Every longest self-reversal common subsequence of a binary five-run word is palindromic
